name: Perfect Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 pounds (900 g) Yukon Gold potatoes or red potatoes
1 cup (235 ml) whole milk or broth (try homemade chicken broth or veggie broth)
¼ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Scrub and dice the potatoes, keeping the pieces similar in size so they cook evenly. (Leave the skin on or peel them, depending on your preference.) Place the potatoes in a large saucepan, add 1 tablespoon of salt, and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to maintain a low simmer.
Cook until the potatoes fall apart easily when pierced with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the milk, broth, and butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat until warm, and the butter has melted.
Drain the potatoes, return them to the hot pot, and cover with a clean dishtowel. Let sit off the heat for about 5 minutes to absorb the excess steam that can make mashed potatoes watery.

Pour the warm milk and butter mixture over the potatoes, then mash until creamy using a potato masher or food mill. (The mixture will seem thin at first, but the potatoes will absorb the liquid after a minute or two.) Stir in the black pepper and a splash of cream, if using.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with additional salt and pepper as needed. Let the potatoes stand for 5 minutes to thicken before serving.
